summary: Grant County, OR site of a 1930s Oregon Dept. of Forestry cabin, later abandoned and gone; registered 2019 as US 1777; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Cabin abandoned, then gone, per FFLOS; no source describes what remains today

events.note: Decade only: FFLOS 'Built' field reads 1930's and firelookout.com reads 1930s. 1930 is the start of the decade, not a dated record.
Registered November 1, 2019 as US 1777, OR 517; nominated by Tammy McLeod

evidence.supports: cabin built on the site in the 1930s, later abandoned and gone
evidence.quote: A cabin was built on the site in the 1930's. It was later abandoned and is gone.

evidence.supports: about 11 miles west-northwest of Mt. Vernon
administered by Oregon Department of Forestry
Oregon Lookouts detail page heads the site Cummings Creek
the page's own navigation list also names it Cummings Peak

corrections.why: FFLOS 'Built' field reads 1930's. No source in the sources read gives an exact year.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and firelookout.com use Cummings Peak. The Oregon Lookouts detail page heads its entry Cummings Creek, while the page's own navigation list also shows Cummings Peak. The story uses Cummings Peak, the register name.

sources.title: Cummings Peak Lookout Site (Grant County)
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites (Forest Fire Lookout Association)

notes_for_editor: Only three short listings exist; no newspaper, Forest Service or ODF record of the cabin's construction, staffing or removal turned up in one search. The brief's conflict note ('They share a register number') could not be checked against these sources; US 1777 is only this site's FFLOS number in the sources read. The brief's 1930 built year is corrected to the 1930s decade. A search returned an unrelated 'Cummins Peak' page for the Siuslaw National Forest, which is not used.
